# freshdesk_contact_fields (Data Source)

Every field on the contact form, built-in and custom.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_contact_fields" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `contact_fields` (Attributes List) Every contact field the API returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contact_fields))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source. Always `contact_fields`.

<a id="nestedatt--contact_fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contact_fields`

Read-Only:

- `agents_can_edit` (Boolean) Whether agents may edit the field.
- `choices` (String) Dropdown options, as JSON.
- `created_at` (String) When the field was created (RFC 3339).
- `customers_can_edit` (Boolean) Whether customers may edit the field.
- `default` (Boolean) Whether this is a built-in field.
- `displayed_for_agents` (Boolean) Whether agents see the field.
- `displayed_for_customers` (Boolean) Whether customers see the field.
- `editable_in_signup` (Boolean) Whether customers may set it at signup.
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the contact field.
- `label` (String) Label shown to agents.
- `label_for_customers` (String) Label shown in the customer portal.
- `name` (String) Internal name of the field.
- `position` (Number) Position of the field on the form.
- `quick_add_for_agent` (Boolean) Whether it appears in the quick-add form.
- `required_for_agents` (Boolean) Whether agents must fill the field in.
- `required_for_customers` (Boolean) Whether customers must fill the field in.
- `type` (String) Field type.
- `unique` (Boolean) Whether values must be unique.
- `updated_at` (String) When the field was last changed (RFC 3339).
